payload.title: Execute arbitrary Tactus procedures in the cloud, not only the three seeded kinds
payload.description: assignment-action executeImmediateProcedureRun dispatches on papyrus-procedure-kind and supports only newsroom.research.explorer, newsroom.reporting.context and ingestion.reference.register; anything else throws Unsupported seeded procedure kind, and the runbook notes Lambda does not execute arbitrary Tactus source. A procedure saved in the newsroom therefore cannot run in the cloud. Needs a runtime that runs any published ProcedureVersion (for example a container Lambda or ECS task with tactus installed), with run records, logs and cost, and the 30 s procedure-action timeout out of the path.
